name: Forget me not
source:
The protagonist Haru, who lives a little different from his peers of the same age rather than ordinary. After spending such a dull day, a transfer student comes on the first day of the new semester… Can Haru’s daily life get better by meeting the transfer student?

[Translated from [url=https://m.apkpure.com/cn/forget-me-not-artemis/net.chanul.pj1_fmn_artemis]Apkpure[/url]]
translation:
主人公Haru过着与同龄人有些不同、算不上平凡的生活。度过又一个沉闷的日子后，新学期的第一天，一名转学生来到了班上……与转学生的相遇，能让Haru的日常有所好转吗？

（译自[url=https://m.apkpure.com/cn/forget-me-not-artemis/net.chanul.pj1_fmn_artemis]APKPure[/url]）
